latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Video Editing With AI.

- Edit and export YouTube-ready videos from raw footage using a cloud AI pipeline.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB in MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM formats; outputs 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple workflows: upload, describe edits (e.g., "cut dead air, add transitions"), and download.
- Automated authentication with free trial credits; session management for iterative editing.
- Direct mapping of user actions and prompts to common YouTube video editing tasks.
